Hello Everyone, 

Welcome to our channel VETBIT, new era of Veterinary 🧑🏻‍⚕️👩🏻‍⚕️.

We are here to serve you 🙏🏻

This channel is for EVERY PASSIONATE 🤩, LOVELY ANIMAL LOVER 😍, PET-PARENTS 👥and VETS 🧑🏻‍⚕️👩🏻‍⚕️.

Here, you will get the answers about your questions regarding SURGERY OF YOUR PETS 🐶 🐱 (Dogs & Cats only) by Veterinary Surgeons (who are on the mission 🎯 to serve the community in best possible ways 🙏🏻. )

So please feel free to ask about any query regarding your pet surgery in comments or in email. 

Please like, share, subscribe our channel 🙏🏻. 

Let’s contribute together 🤝. 

Contact us: vetbit_11 (Instagram)

Email: vetbitdrs11@gmail.com
